C1095.title: Shandong Province Exposes Typical Cases of False and Illegal Advertising
C1095.summary: In November 2018, the Shandong Administration for Market Regulation published 10 typical internet advertising violation cases. By the end of October that year, Shandong market regulators had investigated 356 false and illegal internet advertising cases and imposed 4.32 million yuan in confiscations and fines. The notice listed cases involving Muwanqing Food, Jinan Breast Disease Hospital, and unlawful Baidu promotion agency activity, covering false efficacy claims, exaggerated medical service advertising, and untrue promotions.
